Load DeepCC Model

Source: R/DeepLearning.R
load_DeepCC_model.Rd

Loads a saved DeepCC model. Models trained under Keras 2 before the keras3 migration are rebuilt from their recorded architecture, so the published pre-trained models keep working. Both the new format (with `feature_names` metadata) and the legacy 0.1.1 format are supported.

Usage

load_DeepCC_model(prefix)

Arguments

prefix

file path prefix

Value

a DeepCC model with classifier, levels, and optionally feature_names

See also

[save_DeepCC_model()] to write a model in the current format
